# rediscloud_iris_agent_memory (Resource)

Manages a direct Iris agent-memory resource, independently of Redis Cloud CAPI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rediscloud_iris_agent_memory" "example" {
  name = "application-memory"
  database_json = jsonencode({
    databaseId = "your-database-id"
  })
  long_term_memory_json = jsonencode({
    ttlSeconds = 86400
  })
  flush_on_delete = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_json` (String) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...). The database to store memory data in.
- `name` (String) The name of the memory store.

### Optional

- `custom_memory_types_json` (String) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...). Custom memory types to register on the store. Optional; when omitted the
store uses only built-in memory types.
- `extraction_cadence_json` (String) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...). Cadence configuration for the extraction pipeline.
- `extraction_strategy` (String) Extraction strategy for promoting short-term memory to long-term memory. Defaults
to `INSTRUCT`.
- `flush_on_delete` (Boolean) Delete short-term sessions on destroy. Defaults to false; long-term memories are retained.
- `long_term_memory_exclusions_json` (String) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...). Store-level sensitive-data exclusions policy.
- `long_term_memory_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...). Long-term memory configuration.

On Redis Cloud, `llm` and `embedding` select the store's own models and must be
supplied together; `classification` is independent. Omit them to use the platform
models. The embedding model cannot be changed after the store is created.
- `ownership_json` (String) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...). Controls server-side ownership checks. INHERIT uses the tenant default, then ownership.enabled. Omitted on create means inherit; omitted on update leaves the setting unchanged. When enabled, agent keys need a bound userId or verified delegated user token to access personal content; keys without a user ID can access only shared content within their store grants. Existing ownerless records become hidden and Summary Views with a different ownership policy must be recreated. Disabling restores legacy access. Changes propagate through the metadata cache.
- `short_memory_json` (String) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...). Short-term memory configuration.
- `summarization_json` (String) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...). Configuration for session summarization. When enabled, long sessions are
periodically condensed into a running summary while retaining the most recent events.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The UTC timestamp when the memory store was created.
- `endpoints_json` (String) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...). API endpoints for accessing the memory store.
- `failure_json` (String) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...). Why the store failed to provision. Present only when the store's `state` is
`UNAVAILABLE`. Not returned by ListStores.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier used for import.
- `state` (String) The condition of a provisioned resource, returned as `state`. A resource is usable
when its state is `READY`. A resource reports only the states that apply to it.
- `store_id` (String) Unique identifier for the memory store.
- `subscription_id` (String) The memory store's database subscription ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rediscloud_iris_agent_memory.example st_11111111111111111111111111111111
```
